reason: Rechecked 2026-11-10: upstream is unchanged. No fixed minimatch fits two kinds of caller. minimatch 3.1.5 is still required by the latest @eslint/eslintrc (3.3.7), eslint-plugin-import (2.32.0), eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y (6.10.2) and eslint-plugin-react (7.37.5), which call its CommonJS default export, and eslint-config-next 16.4.6 still bundles those three plugins. typedoc 0.28.20, the latest stable release, still depends on minimatch ^10.2.5 and calls Minimatch.matchOne, which minimatch 11 removed, so its minimatch 10 copy stays too. Both run only at lint and docs time on the repository's own globs and never ship in the built site. The other minimatch 10 copies and every glob 13 copy are overridden to fixed releases in package.json.
